name: Foundation Stone Atronach

abilities.name: Stonegaze
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing high magic damage.

abilities.name: Big Quake
abilities.description: The Atronach slams its "head" into the ground several times, each time dealing moderate-high physical damage in a very large area. This ability must be healed through.

abilities.name: Boulder Storm
abilities.description: The atronach goes into "turtle" mode and hides its head. Stones will be thrown at individual players, each dealing moderate-high physical damage in a small area. The group must spread out and block to prevent shrapnel from hitting each other. If you don't block, you'll be knocked down.

abilities.name: Minions
abilities.description: The Foundation Stone Atronach summons Firstmage Chainspinners and Nullifiers.

notes: The body of a Foundation Stone Atronach can be found in Balamath. A few others can be found in the Deeproot of Earthen Root Enclave.
Generic Stone Atronachs were first introduced in Update 15. Before that, the Foundation Stone Atronach from Update 1 was the only named one.
related_quests: The Mage's Tower: Defeat the Celestial Mage to save her from the Serpent.
summary: The Foundation Stone Atronach is a stone atronach acting as the second boss in the Aetherian Archive. Unlike regular stone atronachs, it is much larger and decorated with ancient Nedic carvings.
